about.title: About
about.p1: I've been working in software development since 2022, when I started as a backend intern with PHP and Laravel. Today I'm a full stack developer at Autoglass, in Vitória, Brazil, where I build and evolve internal systems with Angular, C#, .NET and SQL.
about.p2: My work sits between the interface and the data: versioned REST APIs, OAuth and JWT authentication, permission control, third-party integrations, optimized queries and CI/CD pipelines that take all of it to production.
about.p3: I also worked on N3 support, handling tickets for systems in use. That's where I learned to write code with the next maintainer in mind.

autoglass.description: Building and evolving internal systems with Angular, C#, .NET and SQL, focused on performance, scalability and code quality. .NET version migrations, new features, bug fixes, and writing and optimizing SQL queries. Technical and business refinement and agile ceremonies (planning, daily and retrospective).

aguia-branca.description: Building and maintaining systems with React, Next.js, PHP and C#. REST APIs, internal and external system integration, authentication (OAuth, JWT), permission control and API versioning. Code review, Git Flow and CI/CD with Azure DevOps. Responsive, accessible landing pages.

trinks.description: New features and maintenance of production applications with JavaScript and .NET. Building and evolving REST APIs, data extraction and query optimization. Code review, merges, CI/CD and Git Flow within the team.

code-and-app.description: Features and maintenance in PHP and Laravel with SQL databases. N3 support: handling and resolving technical tickets. Agile team using Scrum.
